name: INK Finance payroll plugin unprotected addSchedulePayee
summary: The INK Finance DAO payroll plugin's addSchedulePayee(scheduleId, payees) has no caller check. A throwaway contract added the attacker's precomputed CREATE2 address to payroll schedule 3 with a 165,162.83 USDT payout; the attacker then deployed that contract, topped the treasury up with a flash loan and called claimPayroll(3), draining the treasury.
notes: Anchored on the payee installation (rule 12): its constructor call to addSchedulePayee ran with no permission check and stored payee 0xd7c64351, the CREATE2 address the drain transaction deployed and claimed with. The plugin is a beacon proxy whose beacon was created with this implementation and never upgraded.
Loss is the treasury 0xa184af4b's whole USDT balance; the 24,982.65 USDT the attacker routed through it from the flash loan came back out in the same transaction.
